map.气动载荷核心量：q=½ρv²，用于升力、阻力、操纵面载荷计算。: A core aerodynamic load quantity: q=½ρv², used for lift, drag and control-surface load calculations.

map.空气密度 ρ=1.225 kg/m³、速度 v=100 m/s，动压 q=½×1: Air density ρ=1.225 kg/m³ and speed v=100 m/s, so dynamic pressure q=½×1.225×100²=6125 Pa (≈0.061 atmosphere). The greater the dynamic pressure, the higher the aerodynamic load and control effectiveness.
map.动压和空速是什么关系？: What is the relationship between dynamic pressure and airspeed?
map.动压与真空速的平方成正比、与密度成正比。同一表速在高空（密度低）动压更小，这也是: Dynamic pressure is proportional to the square of the true airspeed and proportional to density. The same indicated airspeed gives a lower dynamic pressure at altitude (low density), which is why controls feel softer at altitude and the stall true speed is higher.
map.为什么飞机有动压限制？: Why do aircraft have a dynamic-pressure limit?
map.结构（舵面、舱体）与气动弹性（颤振）都受动压上限约束，超过可能在某个高度/速度组: Structures (control surfaces, fuselage) and aeroelasticity (flutter) are all constrained by a dynamic-pressure ceiling; exceeding it may cause structural or control problems at some altitude/speed combination, so the flight envelope is defined jointly by dynamic pressure and Mach number.
